# Innamo

> Innamo (Innamo Travel Ltd) are luxury travel and accommodation booking experts across all of Europe, and offer fully bespoke trip and itinerary planning in Italy. Founded by Nesse, who has spent most of her life in Italy, Innamo uses personal relationships with the finest hotels and villas (many not bookable online) and Virtuoso partnerships to secure upgrades, perks and preferred rates for clients. Ideal for honeymoons, anniversaries, milestone birthdays and any trip that needs to be just right.

- **Anywhere in Europe:** luxury hotel, villa and resort booking, including France, Spain, Portugal, Greece, Croatia, Switzerland, and the Mediterranean and Atlantic islands. Accommodation booking is complimentary, with help on transport and concierge arrangements.
- **Italy:** everything above, plus fully bespoke trip and itinerary planning, from a curated route to a completely managed trip.

## Italy planning tiers

- **Il Percorso (The Route):** a fully bespoke, personally curated Italy itinerary. Clients book everything themselves. A curation fee applies.
- **Il Soggiorno (The Stay):** everything in Il Percorso, plus Innamo books accommodation directly, unlocking Virtuoso upgrades, perks and preferred rates. Accommodation booking is complimentary.
- **L'Esperienza (The Experience):** Innamo handles everything: accommodation, restaurants, transfers, private experiences and tickets.
- [How we work](https://www.innamo.travel/how-we-work)

## Wine & Wellness Retreat, Tuscany (9 to 14 May 2027)

Six days and five nights at Villa Cecconi, a restored medieval watchtower near Siena, run with HerSpace London (a barre and Pilates studio in Parsons Green, London). Two Pilates-based sessions a day, long villa dinners, a day in Siena, and two Chianti wine tastings.

- [Retreat overview](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat)
- [The villa](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat/villa)
- [Movement](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat/movement)
- [Food and wine](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat/food-wine)
- [Pricing and registration](https://www.innamo.travel/retreat/investment)
